program:
app "Ping pong" ball plum
table point team pick Left|Right, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Left)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Right)
setting winat num = 21 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Left" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Left, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Left, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Left, pts = 3
  stack card grow align center
    "Right" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Right, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Right, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Right, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Left win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Right win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Ping pong, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Left, Right; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 21.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Left.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Right.
Shows:
- text: "Left".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Left, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Left, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Left, pts set to 3.
- text: "Right".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 3.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Left win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Right win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

table night slept time, woke time
setting need dur = 8h "Sleep goal"
let avg7 = sum(night last 7 days, (it.woke - it.slept)) / count(night last 7 days)
"Average per week" faint
avg7 big color if(avg7 >= need, good, warn)
"Last wake-up" last(night.woke) faint
daybars last 7 days, sum(night on it, (it.woke - it.slept) / 1h)
form night
list night by day
describe:
Sleep, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- night: slept: time of day; woke: time of day. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Sleep goal": length of time, starts at 8 hours.
Works out:
- avg7 is the sum of the result of its woke minus its slept over the night in the last 7 days divided by how many night entries in the last 7 days.

- text: avg7.
- text: "Last wake-up", the latest woke of night.
- a bar chart of the sum of the result of its woke minus its slept divided by 1 hour over the night on that day for each day in the last 7 days.

program:
app "Savings" coin mint
table deposit amount money, note text?
setting monthly money = 7500 "Saved each month"
setting goal money = 100000
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let left = goal - total
let nm = if(left <= 0, 0, floor(left / monthly) + if(left % monthly > 0, 1, 0))
total "of" goal big
goal total, goal, "saved"
if(left <= 0, "Goal reached", "You reach it around") if(left <= 0, "", monthname(addmonths(today, nm))) head
quick deposit, amount, [5000]
form deposit
list deposit by day
describe:
Savings, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- deposit: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Saved each month": money, starts at 7500; goal: money, starts at 100000.
Works out:
- total is the total amount of deposit.
- left is goal minus total.
- nm is 0 when left is at most 0, otherwise left divided by monthly rounded down plus 1 when left leaves over when divided by monthly is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Shows:
- text: total, "of", goal.
- total out of goal with a progress bar, labelled "saved".
- text: "Goal reached" when left is at most 0, otherwise "You reach it around", "" when left is at most 0, otherwise the month of today moved by nm months.
- one-tap buttons that add a deposit with amount set to each of 5000.
- a form to add a deposit.
- a list of deposit by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words

program:
app "Homework" school plum
table kid name text
table hw kid ref kid, subject text, due date, done bool
each kid as k
  let wk = count(k.hw where due >= today - weekday(today) + 1 and due <= today - weekday(today) + 7)
  let wd = count(k.hw where done = yes and due >= today - weekday(today) + 1 and due <= today - weekday(today) + 7)
  stack card gap 1
    row
      k.name head grow
      "Week score" round(wd * 100 / wk) "%" bold
    each k.hw where done = no sort due as h
      row gap 1
        toggle h.done
        h.subject grow
        h.due small color if(h.due < today, bad, muted)
form kid, "Add child"
form hw, "Add homework"
describe:
Homework, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- kid: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- hw: kid: a kid; subject: text; due: date; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each kid:
  - text: the name of the kid.
  - text: "Week score", wd times 100 divided by wk rounded, "%".
  - for each the kid's hw where done is no sorted by due:
    - a tick box for the done of the hw.
    - text: the subject of the hw.
    - text: the due of the hw.
- a form to add a kid.

table customer name text, rate money "Rate per litre"
table delivery customer ref customer, litres num 0..
table payment customer ref customer, amount money
state m date = today
monthnav m
count(customer) "customers," sum(delivery today, it.litres) "litres delivered today" head
each customer as c
  let bill = sum(c.delivery month of m, it.litres) * c.rate
  stack card gap 1
    row
      c.name bold grow
      "Bill" bill bold
    "Paid" sum(c.payment.amount month of m) ", left" bill - sum(c.payment.amount month of m) faint
    row gap 1
      each [0.5, 1, 2] as v
        button v "L" tap add delivery customer = c, litres = v
form customer, "Add customer"
form payment, "Payment received"
list delivery month of m by day
describe:
Milk shop Buddy, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- customer: name: text; "Rate per litre": money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- delivery: customer: a customer; litres: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- payment: customer: a customer; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: how many customer entries, "customers,", the sum of its litres over the delivery today, "litres delivered today".
- for each customer:
  - text: the name of the customer.
  - text: "Bill", bill.
  - text: "Paid", the total amount of the customer's payment entries in the month of m, ", left", bill minus the total amount of the customer's payment entries in the month of m.
  - for 0.5, 1, 2:
    - a button the value, "L"; a tap adds a delivery with customer set to the customer, litres set to the value.
- a form to add a customer.
- a form to add a payment.
- a list of delivery in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

program:
app "Shopping" bag ink
table purchase what text, amount money, category pick Clothes|Shoes|Gadgets|Beauty|Gifts
state m date = today
let spent = sum(purchase.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 20000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
"Last month" sum(purchase.amount prev month) faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form purchase
list purchase month of m by day
describe:
Shopping, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- purchase: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Clothes, Shoes, Gadgets, Beauty, Gifts. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 20000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of purchase in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Last month", the total amount of purchase last month.
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a purchase.
- a list of purchase in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the problem or reason

program:
app "Late arrivals" clock ink
table late
setting target num = 10 "Count to"
let n = count(late today)
draw width 240 tap add late
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all late today
button "Undo" tap remove last(late today)
remind "Time for late arrivals" at 8:00, 20:00
describe:
Late arrivals, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- late: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Count to": number, starts at 10.
Works out:
- n is how many late entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a late.
- a button "Reset today"; a tap removes all late entries today, with one undo.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest late entries today, with undo.
Reminder "Time for late arrivals" at 8:00, 20:00 every day.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Tea" cup ink
table tea cups num 1..15 unit "cups"
setting goal num = 4 "Daily goal (cups)"
screen main "Today" home
  goal sum(tea.cups today), goal, "today"
  quick tea, cups, [1, 2]
  form tea
screen past "History" chart
  trend days last 14 days, sum(tea.cups on it)
  list tea
describe:
Tea, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- tea: cups: number, 1 to 15, in cups. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily goal (cups)": number, starts at 4.
Shows:
- a screen "Today":
  - the total cups of tea today out of goal with a progress bar, labelled "today".
  - one-tap buttons that add a tea with cups set to each of 1, 2.
  - a form to add a tea.
- a screen "History":
  - a line chart of the total cups of tea on that day over day in the last 14 days.
  - a list of tea; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
